summary: Tested Production Library Import Wizard (backend + frontend). Frontend UI/Wizard renders perfectly: login works, Estimating sidebar entry navigates to /app/production-library, Import tab is present with data-testid='tab-import', clicking it renders ImportWizard step 1 (Initialize Production Library) with the correct copy ('This will create: 14 Knowledge Domains, 11 Service Categories, Standard Measurement Units') and a step indicator showing Initialize → Template → Upload → Validate → Import. The 'initialize-library-btn' button is clickable. HOWEVER, the entire Production Library backend is BROKEN because the required Supabase tables DO NOT EXIST in the Supabase project (oiocmchdtllqpszciuxh). Direct queries to Supabase confirmed: 'Could not find the table public.measurement_units / knowledge_domains / service_categories / production_items in the schema cache' (PGRST205). Consequently: (a) GET /units, /domains, /service-categories, /items, /assemblies all return 500 from FastAPI (Supabase 404 propagated), (b) POST /seed silently returns success=True with 0 created + 0 existing + errors=['FC: 404', 'DH: 404', ...] because the endpoint does not treat per-row Supabase 404s as fatal, (c) After clicking 'Initialize Production Library' in the UI the wizard remains on the 'Library Not Initialized' state (no data was persisted), (d) /import/validate returns 200 with {success:false,error:'library_not_initialized'} because domain lookup is empty. Only /seed/status (returns is_seeded=false, counts all 0) and /import/template/download (fully static payload) work correctly. This is a hard blocker - Supabase migrations for the Production Library schema have not been applied.

critical.issue: Required tables missing in Supabase: measurement_units, knowledge_domains, service_categories, production_items, production_assemblies, production_item_service_categories, production_item_revisions, assembly_items, production_item_attachments. Verified via direct REST call returning PGRST205 'Could not find the table public.<name> in the schema cache'. This breaks the entire Production Library.
Returns 500 'Failed to fetch units' (Supabase returns 404 because measurement_units table does not exist). Blocks the ProductionItemModal 'Measurement Unit' select dropdown.
Returns 500 'Failed to fetch domains' (Supabase 404). Same root cause.
Returns 500 (Supabase 404 on production_items). ProductionLibraryTab shows empty state instead of real items.

SILENT FAILURE - returns 200 {success:true, message:'Production Library seeded successfully'} even when every INSERT to Supabase 404s (table not found). results.knowledge_domains.errors contains 14 rows of '<CODE>: 404' but the endpoint does not surface this. UI reads success and shows a success toast, but nothing was created. Endpoint should return an error (or at least success:false) when both created==0 and existing==0 and errors is non-empty.

minor.issue: Returns 200 with counts all 0 and is_seeded=false when Supabase tables do NOT exist. This masks the underlying infrastructure error - identical response to a legitimate 'not yet seeded' state. Consider bubbling up a schema-missing error so ops can react.
Uses jwt.decode(..., options={'verify_signature': False}) - accepts unsigned tokens. Fine for behind-Supabase, but should verify with Supabase JWT secret in production. Not blocking.
Returns 422 when Authorization header is missing (from Header(...) is required). Standard FastAPI behaviour but /import/validate should return the same, not 401.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking 'Initialize Production Library' and receiving a success response from the backend, the UI does not transition to the seeded state because seed/status still returns is_seeded=false (backend silently failed). User is stuck. UI should also handle the case where POST /seed returns success but the follow-up seed/status still shows is_seeded=false, and warn the user.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend calls POST /seed → gets {success:true} → shows success toast → calls GET /seed/status → is_seeded still false → InitializeStep re-renders in 'Library Not Initialized' branch. This is a silent hand-off failure that is confusing to end users.

fetchReferenceData() Promise.all fires four calls (domains, service-categories, units, stats). Three of them 500. Only 'stats' works. Errors are only console.error'd, no user-facing toast; the UI silently proceeds with empty dropdowns and empty grids.
Pre-existing (from iteration 9) - repeated 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' on /api/workspace/context and useOrganization at initial render. Not new, not blocking this feature.

issues: PRD/original problem statement describes a 7-step workflow (Initialize → Download Template → Drag & Drop CSV → Preview → Validation → Resolve Errors → Summary). Implementation collapses to 5 steps (Initialize, Template, Upload, Validate, Import) - functionally equivalent but does not match PRD verbiage. Consider updating step labels or documenting the mapping.

action_items: CRITICAL: Apply Supabase migrations to create tables: measurement_units (with seed rows for EA/LF/SF/LS/DAY/HR/SET/KIT/PAIR/COST), knowledge_domains, service_categories, production_items, production_assemblies, assembly_items, production_item_service_categories, production_item_revisions, production_item_attachments. Without these tables the entire Production Library is dead. Migration SQL should live in /app/backend/migrations or similar and be run against the Supabase project oiocmchdtllqpszciuxh.

HIGH: Fix POST /api/production-library/seed to return success:false (or an HTTP 500) when both created and existing are 0 AND errors is non-empty. Currently produces a false-positive success response that confuses the wizard.

HIGH: In /api/production-library/seed/status, detect when Supabase returns 404 for the underlying tables (PGRST205) and surface it as `schema_error: true` so the UI can display an actionable message to admins instead of the generic 'Library Not Initialized' branch.

MEDIUM: In ImportWizard.InitializeStep, after clicking Initialize, re-check seed/status and if is_seeded is still false, show an error toast such as 'Initialization failed - contact support' rather than silently returning to the same state.
MEDIUM: In ProductionLibraryPage.fetchReferenceData surface a toast on 5xx responses so users know the backend is not reachable.
LOW: Align ImportWizard step indicator labels with the PRD's 7-step naming, or update the PRD to reflect the 5-step implementation.
LOW: Consider verifying Supabase JWT signature in verify_token_and_get_org for defense-in-depth.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/production_library.py L1760-1764: POST /seed returns `success:true` unconditionally. Should be `success = (results['knowledge_domains']['errors'] == [] and results['service_categories']['errors'] == [])` and status 500 when nothing was created and no rows existed.

backend/routes/production_library.py L1788,1796,1804: /seed/status parses `content-range` header from Supabase responses without checking status_code. When the table is missing Supabase returns 404 with no content-range and the code defaults to '0-0/0' making the response indistinguishable from a real 'empty table' state. Add a status_code==200 guard and surface schema errors explicitly.

backend/routes/production_library.py L186 (get_measurement_units) and similar handlers: On Supabase non-200, they raise HTTPException(status_code=response.status_code, ...). Propagating a Supabase 404 as FastAPI 404 is misleading (the endpoint itself exists). Prefer 502/500 for upstream errors so clients can distinguish routing 404s from data errors.

backend/routes/production_library.py L132: `jwt.decode(token, options={'verify_signature': False})` - unsigned decode. Adequate for local dev but should verify with Supabase JWT secret before shipping to production.

frontend/src/components/production/ImportWizard.jsx L830-865 (handleInitialize): After POST /seed succeeds, only refreshes seed status - no verification that is_seeded actually flipped to true. Add: `if (statusData.is_seeded !== true) toast.error('Initialization failed on the server. Please contact support.')`.

frontend/src/components/production/ImportWizard.jsx L800-825 (checkStatus useEffect): The template fetch is nested inside the seed-status branch; if seed_status is stale/false at first mount and then user initializes, template is only fetched inside handleInitialize's success path. That path exists (L850-854) so this is fine, but code duplication invites drift - factor a shared `fetchTemplate` helper.
frontend/src/pages/app/ProductionLibraryPage.jsx: Multiple unused icon imports (Filter, Sparkles, Tag, FolderOpen, Zap, TrendingUp) - pre-existing carryover from iteration 9. Run eslint --fix.

success_rate.backend: 4/10 tests passing (40%) - /seed/status, /template/download, and auth-required guards work; /seed, /units, /domains, /service-categories, and /import/validate all fail because Supabase schema is missing
success_rate.frontend: 100% for what can be tested without a working backend - Import Wizard UI renders correctly, step indicator visible, all data-testids present, Initialize button clickable. Import flow past step 1 could not be exercised because the library cannot actually be initialized.

seed_data_creation: Attempted to seed via POST /api/production-library/seed but Supabase tables do not exist so nothing was persisted. No cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Root cause of every Production Library failure in this iteration: Supabase project oiocmchdtllqpszciuxh has no production library tables. Direct REST probe (curl to /rest/v1/measurement_units) returns PGRST205 'Could not find the table public.measurement_units in the schema cache'. Once migrations are applied and measurement_units is pre-seeded with EA/LF/SF/LS/DAY/HR/SET/KIT/PAIR/COST rows, the following flow should work end-to-end: click Import tab → Initialize (creates 14 domains + 11 categories) → Continue → Download CSV Template → drop test CSV → Validate → Preview → Commit. The pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_production_library_import.py already contains ready assertions for all seven of these steps and will move from 4/10 passing to 10/10 once the schema is present. Frontend data-testids to reuse: production-library-page, tab-import, initialize-library-btn, continue-to-template-btn, download-template-btn, file-drop-zone, validate-file-btn, proceed-to-import-btn, browse-library-btn.
rca of the issue: Bug reproduction: (1) curl -X POST '{BACKEND}/api/production-library/seed' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <supabase_jwt>' returns 200 {success:true,message:'Production Library seeded successfully',results:{knowledge_domains:{created:0,existing:0,errors:['FC: 404','DH: 404',...14 items]},service_categories:{...}}}. (2) curl 'https://oiocmchdtllqpszciuxh.supabase.co/rest/v1/measurement_units?limit=1' -H 'apikey: <SVC>' returns 404 {code:'PGRST205',message:'Could not find the table public.measurement_units in the schema cache'}. Root cause: the Supabase database migrations that create the Production Library schema (knowledge_domains, service_categories, measurement_units, production_items, production_assemblies, and their join tables) were never applied to the Supabase project referenced by SUPABASE_URL in /app/backend/.env. Mitigation: (a) create and run migration SQL against Supabase, seeding measurement_units with the 10 valid unit codes; (b) harden POST /seed to return a non-success status when all INSERTs fail; (c) harden /seed/status to detect PGRST205 and expose schema_error to the UI; (d) update ImportWizard to display an error when POST /seed reports success but is_seeded stays false.
